Alice M.: Heads-up — discovered a cluster of Vault leases that never rotated and some cross-account service tokens that are still valid past expected TTL. Suspect stale lease renewal from our legacy proxy path. Can we triage and coordinate rotation + audit log handoff? 
Bob K.: Which environments? staging/prod? 
Alice M.: Mostly prod and a couple of partner staging projects (aws-prod-sa accounts and a cross-project GCP SA). 
Carla S.: I can run a sweep; use this to list leases: 
```bash
vault list auth/token/accessors
# then for each accessor:
vault token lookup -accessor $ACCESSOR
``` 
Carla S.: Also check the leases endpoint for K/V mounts: `vault leases list -format=json` 
DevSec Bot: Alert: 2026-03-19 22:10Z detected 74 active revocable tokens older than 30d across 3 namespaces. Ticket #SEC-1059 created. :rotating_light: 
Dave L.: Noted. I remember we had a proxy renewal bug where the agent re-used a cached renewer; might explain 1-2 day lease spikes. We rolled a fix in 2025-11 but didn't backport to the partner branch. 
Erin P.: We should revoke affected tokens first, then rotate underlying KMS-wrapped keys if any were used to wrap secrets. Revocation order: 1) token revoke, 2) revoke leases for secrets engines, 3) rewrap keys/upsert policy. 
Frank T.: Draft playbook: 
- Identify stale tokens: `vault list auth/token/accessors --namespace=...` 
- Map tokens to service accounts via lookup / audit logs 
- Contact owners (automated notify) 
- Revoke tokens in waves, preserve >=1 admin token for rollback 
- Rotate KMS wraps: use customer KMS key rotation API + rewrap via vault transit
- Validate via read-only smoke tests
I'll prep the runbook in the next hour. 
Alice M.: Please include rollback steps (how to re-issue service tokens, how to rehydrate caches). We need a canary revoke before full sweep. 
Judy R.: Where are the audit logs for the partner projects? We send Vault audit to BigQuery (projects:redwood-vault-audit). Query I use: 
```sql
SELECT timestamp, auth.client_token, method, path FROM `redwood-vault-audit.events` WHERE auth.client_token IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
``` 
Judy R.: I can run a join to map tokens->service accounts if we have the accessor column. 
SRE Oncall: I ran `vault list auth/token/accessors -namespace=partners` — output: 137 accessors. Pasted a small sample: 
```text
b2d3...: accessor for service-account:payments-worker
9f4a...: accessor for CI runner:partner-x
...
``` 
SRE Oncall: Revoke dry-run shows 12 will hit production infra; canary of 2 Monday 09:00 UTC? 
Bob K.: Can we schedule the canary 09:00 UTC Monday. I'll be on call. 
Erin P.: I'll own notification templates and the rewrap script. 
Carla S.: Adding labels on Vault entries to track which were rotated: `metadata:rotated_by=sec-sweep-2271112223` 
Frank T.: Also add a post-rotation quality check: sampling of 50 requests across hot paths to ensure no 401/5xx spikes. 
Alice M.: Assigning owners: Bob K. (canary), Erin P. (scripts), Carla S. (sweep), Judy R. (audit joins), Frank T. (post-rotation QA), Dave L. (partner backport). 
DevSec Bot: Reminder scheduled — SEC-1059 runbook draft due in 2 hours. :memo: 
Alice M.: Thanks all. Keep updates here with timestamps and any unexpected failures. 
Bob K.: A couple of quick checks for the runbook: include `vault operator rekey status` steps for KMS-wrapped transit keys and a note about KMS key versioning policy (GCP/CMEK key rotations create new key versions). 
Dave L.: Partner branch backport ticket created: #ENG-4921. ETA EOD. 
Carla S.: Starting sweep now, will post results as I go. 
SRE Oncall: Noted - will prepare rollback scripts and ensure monitoring dashboards are pinned. 
Alice M.: If anyone discovers tokens tied to long-running analytics jobs, ping me immediately before revoking. 
Frank T.: One more: update runbook to include `audit enable file` fallback and how to temporarily route audit to a secondary sink. 
Judy R.: I'll export a token list and attach to SEC-1059 ticket. 
Alice M.: End-to-end plan looks good. Post the runbook link when ready and I'll schedule a postmortem if anything goes sideways.
